title: Heroll: IF Demo
notes: This is the demo of Heroll: IF, by OFFMOON Inc. Unity 6000.3.18f1 game. Ran on dxmt through the Highball Wine 11 (r19) engine (x64-crossover26.3-r19) with Highball's launch environment (HighballKit), launched from the macOS Steam client via Proton-ish (https://github.com/MagnusPladsen/Proton-ish). Everything worked well, no issues noticed.
session: Played for 58 min, launched from macOS Steam through Proton-ish.
